copy.tagline: 通过 Chat SDK 为应用接入 Google Chat 渠道。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想让它能收发 Google Chat 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add Google Chat integration to your app via the Chat SDK.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app and need Google Chat messaging.

howto.what: 它会把 Google Chat 适配器从 channels 分支复制进 src/channels/ 并在频道入口注册,安装 @chat-adapter/gchat@4.29.0,然后构建并运行注册测试。Google Cloud 凭据仍需你自己在控制台配置。
howto.when: 当你想给项目加上 Google Chat 频道时,通常由 /setup 流程或你直接调用本技能进入。

say.text: 给项目加上 Google Chat 频道
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册,再构建并跑测试

say.text: 把 gchat 适配器重新复制一遍
say.note: 每一步都幂等,重跑是安全的
检查入口导入和依赖是否漂移

howto.what_en: Copies the Google Chat adapter from the channels branch into src/channels/, registers it in the channel barrel, installs @chat-adapter/gchat@4.29.0, then builds and runs the registration test. Cloud credentials are still set up by hand.
howto.when_en: When you want to add Google Chat as a channel to the project, typically during /setup or by invoking this skill directly.

say_en.text: Add a Google Chat channel to this project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, then builds and tests

say_en.text: Re-copy the gchat adapter from the channels branch
say_en.note: Every step is idempotent, so re-running is safe
Checks the barrel import and the adapter install
